kpis.description_fr: Revenu segment Pulp & Paper (chimie pour pâte à papier + emballage carton/recyclé + tissue). Cœur historique Kemira. 59% du CA.
kpis.description_en: Pulp & Paper segment revenue (chemicals for pulp + cardboard/recycled packaging + tissue). Kemira's historical core. 59% of revenue.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu segment Industry & Water (traitement de l'eau municipal + industriel, oil & gas chemicals). Plus forte rentabilité.
kpis.description_en: Industry & Water segment revenue (municipal + industrial water treatment, oil & gas chemicals). Highest profitability.

kpis.description_fr: Marge EBITDA opérative (operative EBITDA / revenue). Record historique avec deux segments à marge record en 2023.
kpis.description_en: Operative EBITDA margin (operative EBITDA / revenue). Historical record with both segments at record margins in 2023.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu généré par les solutions à base renouvelable. 59% des produits Kemira améliorent l'efficacité ressources (target ESG).
kpis.description_en: Revenue generated by renewable-based solutions. 59% of Kemira products improve resource efficiency (ESG target).

_notes: Kemira = chimie spéciale Finlande (Pulp & Paper + Industry & Water). KPIs spécifiques aux 2 segments + Operative EBITDA Margin (KPI signature reporting Kemira) + Renewables (strategic shift). Source 2024 annual report (1.7MB).

kpis_story.description_fr: Reprise du cycle pulp & paper en 2024 après destockage 2023 : volumes chemicals en hausse, marges en redressement.
kpis_story.description_en: Pulp & paper cycle recovery in 2024 after 2023 destocking: rising chemicals volumes, margin improvement.
